verdict.rationale: Flagright markets AI agents for AML operations, so asking whether those agents can use tools from external MCP servers is a fair question. The pack has no evidence that Flagright can register or connect to external MCP servers. The only MCP mention is a docs MCP server that outside AI clients such as Claude Code or Cursor connect to, which is the server role and does not count for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
